passages.title: Ukážka 1 – Tom’s new school
passages.body: Tom started at a new school in September. At first he felt nervous because he did not know anyone. On the first day, a girl called Mia showed him the library and the canteen. They both love chess, so they joined the school chess club. Now Tom meets his new friends there every Wednesday after lessons. He says that moving to a new school was scary, but it was worth it.

passages.title: Ukážka 2 – Plastic in the sea
passages.body: Every year, millions of tonnes of plastic end up in the oceans. Sea animals often mistake it for food, and many of them get sick. Scientists say that most plastic comes from the land, not from ships. Some towns now ban plastic bags, and volunteers clean beaches at weekends. Experts agree that the best solution is to use less plastic in the first place.

questions.prompt: My brother ___ football every Saturday.
questions.explanation: Pravidelný zvyk = present simple, pri he/she/it pridáme -s.

questions.prompt: Be quiet! The baby ___.
questions.explanation: Dej prebieha práve teraz = present continuous.

questions.prompt: Dopíš správny tvar: She ___ (not like) coffee.
questions.explanation: Záporná veta v 3. osobe: does not + základný tvar.

questions.prompt: ___ you usually have breakfast at home?
Dopíš sloveso v správnom tvare: Look! It ___ (rain).
questions.explanation: Look! signalizuje dej, ktorý prebieha teraz.

questions.prompt: Last summer we ___ to Italy.
I ___ my keys yesterday.
Tomorrow I ___ my grandmother.
questions.explanation: Rozhodnutie alebo predpoveď o budúcnosti: will + základný tvar.

questions.prompt: Dopíš minulý čas: He ___ (write) a letter last week.
Look at those clouds! It ___ rain.
questions.explanation: Vidíme znak, že sa niečo stane: going to.

questions.prompt: Čo znamená „knee“?
Which word is the opposite of “generous”?
Dopíš anglický preklad slova „zajtra“:
I need to ___ a decision before Friday.
questions.explanation: Správne spojenie je make a decision.

questions.prompt: Dopíš slovo: A person who teaches at school is a ______.
I was born ___ 2010.
She is ___ honest girl.
questions.explanation: Honest začína samohláskovým zvukom, preto an.

questions.prompt: We arrived ___ the airport at noon.
questions.explanation: Arrive at pri menších miestach, arrive in pri mestách.

questions.prompt: Doplň predložku: The film starts ___ 7 p.m.
___ Sun rises in the east.
You ___ wear a seat belt. It is the law.
If it rains tomorrow, we ___ at home.
questions.explanation: Reálna podmienka: if + prítomný čas, will.

questions.prompt: If I ___ rich, I would buy a boat.
Dopíš modálne sloveso: ___ I open the window? (Môžem otvoriť okno?)
questions.explanation: Žiadosť o dovolenie: can, may alebo could.

questions.prompt: You ___ park here. It is forbidden.
Why did Tom feel nervous at first?
questions.explanation: V texte: he did not know anyone.

questions.prompt: What do Tom and Mia have in common?
options: They are in the same class.
questions.explanation: V texte: They both love chess.

questions.prompt: Napíš, v ktorý deň sa schádza šachový klub (jedno slovo):
According to the text, where does most plastic come from?
What do experts recommend?
questions.explanation: Najlepšie riešenie je používať menej plastu.
